title: Loops
explanation: A for loop repeats a block a set number of times. Its three parts are: where to start, how long to keep going, and what to change after each pass.
for (int y = 1; y <= 8; y++) runs with y as 1, 2, 3 ... 8. The y++ is shorthand for add one to y.
This is where code beats placing blocks by hand. Change the 8 to 40 and you get a 40-block tower for exactly the same effort.
